The dish looks like roasted squash or pumpkin pieces on a plate about 20-26 cm across. The plate spans roughly 360 px, which gives about 0.06-0.07 cm per px if it is a 24 cm plate.

The pile of pieces measures about 220 px by 230 px, or roughly 14 cm across. There are about 6-7 chunks, each around 5 cm long, 2.5 cm wide and 2 cm thick. That is about 25 cm³ per chunk, so 7 chunks come to roughly 175 cm³, or about 150-180 g.

Roasted squash runs about 1.0-1.4 kcal/g, and adding some oil and caramelization puts it near 1.3 kcal/g. At about 160 g that gives roughly 200 kcal.
